newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Briton jailed in Morocco over drugs.
newsitem.headline: Briton jailed in Morocco over drugs.

text.p: British citizen Robert Jarman has been jailed in Morocco for three years for drug trafficking, British officials said on Friday.
Yorkshire-born Jarman, 37, was arrested on March 1 at Casablanca airport with 1.2 kg (2.6 pounds) of cannabis hidden in his shoes. He was about to board a flight to London.
Jarman, married to a Moroccan and with one child, had been living in the north Moroccan town of Tangier. He was sentenced on Thursday by a Casablanca court.
Around 40 Britons are in jail in Morocco with convictions for drug smuggling.
